description: Modernise the student-facing and results screens: StudentDashboard, ExamDeliveryRoom, ReportCardModal, and ResultsPublication. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-002 (admin/teacher screens) — it touches a completely different set of files. It depends on FEAT-001 (the shared primitives must be updated first). These four screens are the most visible to end-users and have the most distinct layout requirements: ExamDeliveryRoom needs a full-screen layout overhaul, ReportCardModal needs a print-friendly treatment, ResultsPublication needs its workflow action buttons replaced with proper Button primitives and its modal converted to the Modal primitive.

findings: All four screens modernised successfully. StudentDashboard: welcome banner converted to Card primitive, exam cards use Card hoverable, badges used for meta info, Button primitives throughout, loader-ring loading state. ExamDeliveryRoom: header bar converted from dark slate-900 to white/light, autosave indicator uses Badge variants, timer uses light-theme classes with red-50/red-300 for critical state, answer options use indigo-600 border/bg-indigo-50 when selected, nav buttons use Button primitives, submit button uses style={{background:'#059669'}} override, sidebar uses Card padding='sm', palette buttons updated with indigo-600 for current. ReportCardModal: kept custom overlay (not Modal primitive) for printable layout, modal header bar changed from dark slate-900 to slate-50 light, student metadata grid uses correct label/value classes, subject table has alternating row striping, PASS/FAIL uses Badge variants, academic standing footer changed from bg-slate-900 to bg-indigo-700. ResultsPublication: filter selects use Select primitive with labels, status display uses StatusBadge, all workflow buttons use Button primitives, rank cell uses indigo-600 font-mono, outcome uses Badge variants, report card link uses Button ghost, unlock modal uses Modal primitive with ModalFooter, reason textarea uses Textarea primitive. npm run lint: exit 0. npm run build: exit 0.
